title: Treasures of Bali | From Sacred Sites to Beach Side
highlights: Enjoy a journey through Bali’s scenic landscapes, where sacred temples, cascading waterfalls, lush rice terraces, and vibrant culture create memories to last a lifetime.
Marvel at the Tegallalang Rice Terraces, where emerald-green steps carved into the hills showcase Bali’s timeless agricultural traditions and breathtaking beauty.
Soar high on the iconic Bali Swing, feeling the rush of adrenaline as you glide above dense jungles and rice fields, capturing views that define adventure.
Witness the Gitgit Waterfall, where cool waters cascade through tropical forests, offering a refreshing escape amid nature’s raw beauty.
Snorkel in the crystal-clear waters of Crystal Bay, where vibrant coral gardens and colorful fish reveal the underwater treasures of Bali’s island paradise.
overview:
About the Tour:
Discover the best of Bali with this 6-day tour that blends culture, nature, and adventure. Begin your journey in Ubud, where you can explore Celuk Village’s silver artistry, the sacred Tirta Empul Temple, or the lush Bali Bird Park. Continue with a central sightseeing tour through Kintamani Highlands for views of Mount Batur, a coffee plantation experience, Tegenungan Waterfall, and the iconic Bali Jungle Swing. Transfer to Kuta with visits to Handara Gate, Ulun Danu Temple on Lake Beratan, and the stunning Gitgit Waterfall. Cruise to Nusa Penida to marvel at Angel’s Billabong, Broken Bay, and Crystal Bay’s snorkelling paradise. In Kuta, explore GWK Cultural Park, the clifftop Uluwatu Temple with its Kecak dance, and relax at Padang Padang Beach before your journey concludes.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Bali | Transfer to Ubud | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Bali! Upon arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport, get driven to your hotel in Ubud. Post check-in, spend the day at leisure, where you can head out & visit Celuk Village, famed for its exquisite silver artistry, and watch master craftsmen at work. Also, you can explore the sacred springs of Tirta Empul Temple or visit the Bali Bird Park, home to hundreds of exotic species amidst lush tropical gardens, offering an immersive encounter with vibrant wildlife.

days.title: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, embark on a scenic sightseeing tour of Bali. Start with a visit to Kintamani Highlands, offering panoramic views of Mount Batur and its volcanic landscape. Continue to a local coffee plantation, discovering traditional brewing methods and savoring fresh flavors over a delightful packed lunch. Next, visit Tegenungan Waterfall & cool off in its natural pool, then admire the lush Tegalalang Rice Terraces. Conclude your day with an adrenaline rush on the iconic Bali Jungle Swing.

days.title: Transfer to Kuta | Handara Gate & Ulun Danu with Git Git Waterfall Tour
days.desc: Post checkout, board your transfer & get driven to Kuta. En route, embark on a scenic tour that begins at the iconic Handara Gate, a picture-perfect spot framed by lush mountains and traditional Balinese architecture. Continue to the Ulun Danu Beratan Temple, beautifully set on the shores of Lake Beratan. Later, visit the stunning Gitgit Waterfall, cascading amidst tropical greenery, before proceeding to your hotel in Kuta. Upon arrival, check-in to your hotel and enjoy your overnight stay.

days.title: Nusa Penida West Tour
days.desc: Today, get driven to Sanur Harbor and board a speedboat to the iconic island of Nusa Penida, famed for its rugged beauty and romantic charm. Begin with Angel’s Billabong, a natural infinity pool where emerald waters glisten against rocky cliffs. Next, witness the dramatic seascape of Broken Bay with its striking rock arch. Continue to Crystal Bay, perfect for a shoreline stroll or snorkeling among vibrant marine life. After an amazing time, get driven to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Visit to GWK Park | Uluwatu Temple Tour | Trip to Padang Padang Beach
days.desc: Today, get driven to visit the GWK Cultural Park, where towering statues, cultural performances, and panoramic views showcase Bali’s rich heritage. Continue to the iconic Uluwatu Temple, perched dramatically on a cliff overlooking the Indian Ocean, and admire its sunset views paired with the famed Kecak dance performance. Later, relax at Padang Padang Beach, a hidden gem with soft sands, turquoise waters, and dramatic rock formations. After an amazing time, get driven to the hotel.
